topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: For every debit there will be an equal credit according to ________.
e: Correct answer: Duality concept (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: AXL Ltd purchased a an office space for Rs. 75 lakhs in Jan 2015. An amount of Rs. 5 lakhs was spent. for further development and Rs. 5 lakhs for registration charges in the same year. At the year end the market value of the said building was found to be Rs. 95 lakhs. What is the value of the office to be recorded in the books as per the historical cost concept?
e: Correct answer: Rs. 85 lakhs (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Investments in equity shares listed on a registered stock exchange should be made only if they are:-

I. Actively traded and liquid instruments
II. Thinly traded
III. Through mutual funds
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following is not one of the reasons for an enterprise to make changes in its accounting policies ?

I. To inflate the profits of the company
II. To comply with the provisions of law
III. To bring the books of accounts in consonance with the actual position
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: With regards to dual aspect concept, which among the following is incorrect?
o: It increases one asset and simultaneously decrease
It increases one asset and simultaneously increases another asset
It increases one asset and simultaneously increase
It decreases one asset and decreases a liability
It increases one liability and decreases another l
e: Correct answer: It increases one asset and simultaneously increases another asset (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following statements are true?

I. At least 65% of long term debt instruments including Government and Other Approved Securities and Investment Assets in case of general insurance co. shall have a rating of AAA
II. At least 65% of shot term debt instruments including Government and Other Approved Securities and Investment Assets shall have a rating of PI+
III. An insurer shall have investments of more than 5% of its total investments in companies belonging to promoters.
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: A Ltd. Decided redeem its 10,000 10%-Redeemable Preference shares of Rs. 10 each fully paid by issue of sufficient number equity shares of Rs. 10 each at premium of Rs. 2 each. Redemption will be at par.  Evaluate the correct journal entry to be passed at the time of issue of shares.
e:
Correct answer: Bank A/c ............................ Dr. - Rs. 12,000
To Equity Share Capital A/c .................... Cr. Rs. 10,000
To Security Premium A/c ..................... Cr. Rs. 2,000 (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Britania Ltd. has purchased some office equipment from ABC Ltd on credit. Which type of account is ABC ltd.'s in the books of Britania Ltd?

I. Nominal
II. Real
III. Personal
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: In financial statements for general insurance companies, the net underwriting result are transferred from Revenue Accounts to which of the following accounts?
e: Correct answer: Profit and Loss Account (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which form is submitted for the statement of investments reconciliation?
e: Correct answer: Form 5 (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Under this method of depreciation the amount of depreciation ascertained with reference to the present value of the capital investment or the original cost of the asset, with the help of a Logarithmic table. Which method of charging depreciation is this?

I. Reducing Balance Method
II. Annuity Method
III. Straight Line Method
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: As per the IRDAI (Investment) (Fifth Amendment) Regulations 2013 every insurer carrying on general insurance business shall invest in Central Government Securities, State Government Securities or other approved securities  ________.
e: Correct answer: Not less than 30% (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: In which book of original entry is VAT on purchases from a non-credit supplier recorded?
e: Correct answer: Cash Book (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Define Long-term investment as per the AS 13. Choose the most appropriate answer
o: Long-term investment is an investment which is intended to be held for more than one year from the date when such investments are made
Long-term investment is an investment made in inve
Long-term investment is an investment made in the
Long-term investment is an investment which by its
Long-term investment are the investments which are
e: Correct answer: Long-term investment is an investment which is intended to be held for more than one year from the date when such investments are made (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: A trial balance can be relied to detect which of the following types of errors?
o: Posting to the wrong side of any account
Amounts posted to the correct side of a wrong acco
e: Correct answer: Posting to the wrong side of any account (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
As per AS 19 Accounting for leases, which of the following does not fall in the scope of this standard?

I. Lease for mining minerals
II. Licensing agreements for motion picture films
III. Licensing agreements for copyrights
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
As per AS 22 Accounting for Taxes and income, which of the following is correct?

I. Deferred tax assets and liabilities should not be discounted to their present value
II. Deferred tax assets and liabilities should be measured using the tax rates and tax laws
III. Deferred tax is recognised for temporary and permanent difference both
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following statements are correct with regards to the general instruction for preparation of financial statements of a general insurance company?

I. The figures should be rounded of to nearest lakhs
II. Income from rent may include any notional rent
III. Interest/Dividend received shall be recorded at gross value and corresponding tax deducted recoded under advance tax paid
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: What do you mean by the underwriting results in the insurance business?
o: The 'Earned Premium' in accounting the year is kno
Underwriting results are obtained by deducting all costs or expenses incurred for the particular year from the 'Earned Premium' in the year
Underwriting results are obtained by deducting ope
Underwriting results are obtained by deducting the
Underwriting results the sum of all costs or expen
e: Correct answer: Underwriting results are obtained by deducting all costs or expenses incurred for the particular year from the 'Earned Premium' in the year (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment

e: Correct answer: Section 92 (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
A debit balance of Rs. 1,000 has been brought forward as a credit balance of Rs.100 on the next page in the pass book. To ascertain the balance as per cash book:

I. Rs.900 should be added to the balance as per pass book
II. Rs.900 should be subtracted from the balance as per pass book
III. Rs.1,100 should be added to the balance as per pass book
o: Neither I, nor II, nor III
e: Correct answer: Neither I, nor II, nor III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Device a term to describe the specific accounting principles and the methods of application of those specific principles adopted by an enterprise in the preparation and presentation of its financial statements.
e: Correct answer: Accounting Policies (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Financial Accounting is concerned with the accounting  of which of the following types of activities?
e: Correct answer: Economic activities (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
As per AS 15 Accounting for retirement benefits, which of the following are the features of defined contribution plans?

I. The enterprise's obligation is limited to the amount that it agrees to contribute to the fund
II. Actuarial risk lies with the company
III. Investment risk lies with employee
e: Correct answer: I and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
As per the Companies Act, a Directors report should disclose comparative information with regards to which of the following?

I. Net Premium and percentage of growth over previous year
II. Increase in Unexpired Risks Reserve and percentage to net premium
III. Net Premium Earned
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which of the following reports is to be placed before the Parliament by a government company?
e: Correct answer: Annual report (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment

e: Correct answer: 45 days (from the IC46 question bank).

t: Siddhi Vinayak Ltd. has insured the business of Mr. Shyam and has got the 50% of his risk insured from KIC Ltd. Who is KIC Ltd here?
e: Correct answer: Reinsurer (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following statements are false?

I. The exposure limit for the financial sector and banking sector should be at 25% investment assets for all insurers
II. Half yearly investment returns should be submitted by every insurer to the Regulator
III. Such investment returns shall be duly verified/ certified by CEO/ chief of investment
e: Correct answer: I and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Device a term to describe the process of recording and reporting of financial transactions including the origination of the transaction, its recognition, processing and summarisation in the financial statements.
e: Correct answer: Accounting (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
While making which of the following payments is the company required to deduct tax source?

I. Interest
II. Dividend
III. Salaries
e: Correct answer: I and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Arrange the steps in accounting in proper sequence. (Starting from first to last).

I. Classifying
II. Reporting
III. Recording
IV. Analysing
e: Correct answer: I, III, IV and II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Form 5 an investment return, required to be submitted by an insurance company discloses information on ______________.
e: Correct answer: Investment reconciliation (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: _________ are those items of incomes or expenses which arise in the current period owing to errors or omissions in the preparation of the financial statements of one or more earlier periods.
e: Correct answer: Prior period items (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Ind AS deals with which of the following issues in the financial statements?

I. Recognition of events and transactions in the financial statements
II. Measurement of the transactions and events
III. Presentation of the financial transactions in the financial statements
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: The bank reconciliation statement shows a balance of Rs.5,000 according to the cash book. The balance according to the pass book is Rs.3,028. The amount of cheque deposited not yet credited is Rs.2,682.  What is the amount of unpresented cheques?
e: Correct answer: Rs.710 (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Accounting policies of an enterprise depend on which of the following factors?

I. Nature of the organisation
II. Structure of the organisation
III. Location of its head office
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Under the written down value method of providing depreciation, depreciation expense:
o: Increase in initial year and decreases in later ye
Decreases in initial year and increases in later y
e: Correct answer: Decrease each year (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Device a term to describe the statement that determines the net profit i.e., final operating surplus available for its distribution to government, the proprietors or partners or shareholders as the case may be.
e: Correct answer: Profit & Loss account (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: In accordance with AS 6, which of the following assets does not fit into the definition of a depreciable asset?
e: Correct answer: Land (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: As per AS 15 Accounting for retirement benefits, which method is used to measure the obligations?
e: Correct answer: Projected Unit Credit Method (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Devise a term to define an independent appraisal function, established within an organisation to examine and evaluate its activities as a service to the organisation.
e: Correct answer: Internal Audit (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: A firm purchases a computer and makes payment by cheque for Rs. 40,000. In this case computer A/c will be debited for Rs. 40,000 and __________ will be credited for the same amount.
e: Correct answer: Bank A/c (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following areas are not within the scope of IFRS 4 Insurance Contracts?

I. Insurance contracts which an entity holds as a policyholder
II. Contingent consideration that has arisen as a result of a business combination
III. Provision of warranty given by manufacturers
o: Neither I, Nor II, Nor III
e: Correct answer: Neither I, Nor II, Nor III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
A bank reconciliation statement is prepared to:

I. To know the reasons for the difference between the opening and closing balance according to the bank statement
II. To know the similarities between the bank balance according to the bank statement and the cash book
III. To know the reasons for the difference between the bank balance according to the bank statement and the cash book
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which among the following accounting standards is not applicable to insurance companies?

I. Disclosure of accounting policies
II. Valuation of inventories
III. Cash flow statements
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: A general insurance company is required to invest a minimum of _____ percent of the total investments, in Bonds /Debentures, Equity and Asset Backed Securities with underlying infrastructure assets.
e: Correct answer: 20% (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Ajay's is the owner of a business and his private telephone expenses are allocated to his business. It shall be against which of the following accounting concepts?
e: Correct answer: Separate Entity Concept (from the IC46 question bank).
